name: Warrior Met Coal
inflation_thesis: Low-cost US met-coal pure play whose Blue Creek mine lifts volumes 45-65% on a largely fixed cost base, so any commodity reflation drops straight to earnings. Hard asset with long reserve life.
key_risks: Met-coal prices depend on Asian steel demand more than US CPI; single-commodity concentration.

name: Darling Ingredients
inflation_thesis: Sells USD-priced fats, proteins and renewable diesel whose prices track food, feed and diesel inflation, while raw material is bought on formula contracts, so spreads widen when finished prices rise. Its rendering network is a costly-to-replicate hard-asset footprint.
key_risks: Heavy dependence on US biofuel policy (RVO, 45Z, RINs).
notes: FY1 revenue = TTM proxy. Price is from end of July.

name: Marex Group
inflation_thesis: Leading clearer/broker in energy, metals and agri commodities: inflation-driven commodity volatility raises hedging and clearing volumes, and higher-for-longer rates lift interest earned on client margin balances.
key_risks: Earnings fall if volatility calms or the Fed cuts.
notes: FY1 consensus looks stale (H1-26 EPS already $3.29).

name: CEMEX
inflation_thesis: Cement and aggregates are local, high-barrier products whose pricing has historically beaten CPI; its large US business benefits from infrastructure and reshoring spend.
key_risks: Mexico/FX exposure; energy-cost inflation in kilns.

name: Star Bulk Carriers
inflation_thesis: USD dry-bulk rates track commodity trade; fleet replacement cost rises with inflation.

name: Kelt Exploration
inflation_thesis: Fast-growing producer whose condensate, NGLs and oil are priced off USD WTI, with rising exposure to US/LNG-linked gas; revenue is forecast up ~77% in 2026.

name: Serica Energy
inflation_thesis: Production stepping up from 27.6k to 40k+ boe/d, all Brent/NBP priced in USD; net cash.
key_risks: UK Energy Profits Levy (78%); Triton FPSO downtime.

name: Endeavour Silver
inflation_thesis: Silver is the highest-beta monetary metal.

name: Nexa Resources
inflation_thesis: Sells USD-priced zinc, copper, silver and lead against costs in Peruvian soles and Brazilian reais, so US inflation and a weaker dollar lift prices faster than costs. As both miner and smelter it has strong operating leverage: EPS jumps from $1.00 in 2025 to ~$2.9 expected.
key_risks: High leverage and smelter capex, Votorantim control, Peru permitting risk; consensus has 2028 EPS falling and many targets (~$11) sit below the price.
notes: TickFlow consensus averages; analyst count approximate (5-7). Q3 results 29-Oct-2026.

name: Anglo Asian Mining
inflation_thesis: Turning from a small gold miner into a copper-gold producer (copper 7.9kt to 20-25kt in 2026); H1-26 PBT $68.5m vs $7.1m.
key_risks: Azerbaijan PSA risk; thin coverage; stale price.

name: YPF
inflation_thesis: Shifting from a peso-regulated refiner to a dollar shale-oil exporter via new pipelines; fuel prices track import parity.

name: SLC Agrícola
inflation_thesis: USD-priced crops with BRL costs; R$13.5bn farmland.

name: DOF Group
inflation_thesis: Tight CSV/OSV supply, USD dayrates, 11-12% yield.

name: Capital Clean Energy Carriers
inflation_thesis: Newbuild LNG and gas-carrier fleet with ~$2.9bn of USD contracted revenue and deliveries through 2029; high-replacement-cost ships whose value rises with yard inflation, while US energy exports support charter demand. EPS grows into 2027-28 as ships deliver.
key_risks: Fixed long-term charters don't reprice; capex/debt-heavy newbuild programme; family control.
notes: FY0 includes ship-sale gains. Estimates disagree (tickflow 2.77/2.71/2.56). 2028 revenue extrapolated.

name: Euroseas
inflation_thesis: Small-cap feeder containership owner with most 2026-27 days fixed at ~$31k/day in USD and 12 newbuilds (ordered below today's inflated yard prices) growing the fleet from 25 to 33 ships by 2029.
key_risks: Feeder rates may weaken as charters roll; illiquid, family-controlled.

name: Global Ship Lease
inflation_thesis: $3.2bn USD contracted backlog; hard-to-replace mid-size ships.

name: Alamtri Resources Indonesia
notes: FY28 extrapolated; price may have eased to ~Rp2,560.

name: NALCO
inflation_thesis: Low-cost integrated aluminium; LME USD prices, INR costs; net cash.

name: Triputra Agro Persada
inflation_thesis: USD palm oil, IDR costs; net cash.

name: Mitsubishi Materials
inflation_thesis: Earnings come from USD-priced copper, gold and tungsten plus copper-mine equity income, translated at a weak yen. In Aug-2026 it nearly tripled FY3/27 net-profit guidance to ¥140bn (a 19-year record) on metal prices and inventory gains — exactly how a hard-asset business benefits when US inflation lifts commodity prices.
key_risks: Much of FY3/27 profit is one-off inventory gains that reverse if metals or the yen turn; smelting is low-margin.
notes: FY1 = consensus ¥791 (company guidance ≈¥1,073 would give 4.8x). FY2 consensus (¥485.5) pre-dates the guidance hike and is likely too low; FY3 extrapolated flat.

name: Sojitz
sub_industry: Mid-size trading house (metals, coal, energy, chemicals)
inflation_thesis: Much of its profit comes from USD-linked coal, rare earths (via Lynas), nickel and alumina plus commodity trading and overseas assets, all reported in a weak yen, so higher USD commodity prices lift both mining income and trading margins. FY3/27 net profit is guided +25% and it trades at ~1x book with buybacks.
key_risks: Coal-price fall or sharp yen rebound; cyclical non-resource businesses.
notes: FY0 derived from consensus growth; revenue consensus on a different basis; FY3 revenue extrapolated. Dividend yield ~3.1%.

name: Hanwa
inflation_thesis: Metals trader; gains on inventory as prices rise; 0.86x book.

name: Inpex
inflation_thesis: USD oil/LNG revenue at a weak yen.

name: Black Stone Minerals
inflation_thesis: Owns ~20m gross acres of mineral and royalty interests with no drilling or operating costs, so higher US gas/oil prices go almost entirely to distributable cash. Operator-funded development of its Shelby Trough/Haynesville acreage grows volumes into 2027-28 while LNG exports support Gulf Coast gas prices.
key_risks: Gas-price sensitivity; hedge mark-to-market losses (why 2026 GAAP EPS dips); reliance on operators' drilling schedules.
notes: 2026 EPS range $0.70-1.09 (hedge losses). 2028 revenue from a model.

name: Select Harvests
inflation_thesis: Almond prices are set in USD by Californian supply, which carries US water, labour and energy inflation; Select Harvests sells from lower-cost Australian orchards and owns land and water rights.
key_risks: Large Californian crop; hedged FY26 crop.

name: Caledonia Mining
inflation_thesis: Unhedged USD gold, weak ZiG costs, Bilboes to 2.5x output.

name: YONFER Agricultural Technology
inflation_thesis: Integrated phosphate-to-NPK producer with captive rock.

name: Mongolian Mining Corp
inflation_thesis: Sells USD/CNY-priced coking coal to Chinese steel mills from a weak-tugrik cost base, and volumes are rising (H1-26 sales 5.7Mt vs 4.2Mt). Its new Bayan Khundii gold mine adds a classic inflation hedge (16% of H1 revenue).
key_risks: China/border-logistics dependence; Mongolian resource nationalism; no real consensus.
notes: No consensus: 2026 EPS = H1-26 actual x2 (run-rate ~6.5x P/E). FY0 2025 profit near zero (bond-redemption loss). 2027-28 unavailable.

name: Thungela
inflation_thesis: Pure USD thermal exporter, net cash.

name: Hallador Energy
sub_industry: Integrated coal mine + 1 GW Merom power plant (MISO)
inflation_thesis: Mines its own coal and burns it at its 1 GW Merom plant, so rising MISO power and capacity prices fall straight to margin while fuel cost is captive. Data-centre load growth and PPA talks are re-rating dispatchable baseload, and an existing plant costs far more to replace under inflation.
key_risks: Data-centre PPA may not be signed; merchant power volatility; single-plant concentration.
notes: FY0 EPS derived. TickFlow averages; B. Riley lower (0.51/0.85/0.55).

name: Peabody Energy
inflation_thesis: Largest US coal producer; Centurion met ramp.

name: Core Natural Resources
inflation_thesis: USD thermal and met coal + Baltimore terminal.

name: Alpha Metallurgical Resources
inflation_thesis: Largest US pure met coal producer.
